title: Full faithfulness implies bijectivity of the component section map
statement: In the situation of the explicit component section map [def-zl-component-section-map], if componentInverse T is fully faithful, then componentSectionMap Lambda T alpha is bijective. Weak contractibility is not an assumption of this algebraic implication.

proof.text: The source terminal-section equivalence is bijective. Full faithfulness makes Γ.mapFunctor bijective. Γ.map α is bijective: injectivity follows by cancelling α.hom and surjectivity sends y to y composed with α.inv. Target terminal evaluation is bijective. Compose these four bijections.
